answer: Work-history threads: each agent carries one hash-linked thread of signed job receipts, and every receipt names its buyer, the job and the prior link, so it can sit in only one thread. Rewards unlock after 30 receipts from 10 distinct buyers. Clones cannot share a thread; each fake needs its own 30 real jobs, about 15 hours and 6 POA in fees, so 100 fakes cost 1,500 hours. New keys stay a dim nebula of zero-weight noise until they grow their own grove of paying buyers.
